name: hashfuncs
description: Fast non-cryptographic hash functions for DuckDB. xxHash, RapidHash, and MurmurHash3 — at speeds approaching RAM bandwidth. Built for partitioning, sharding, cache keys, and as input to probabilistic filters.

cta.title: Hash at RAM Speed
cta.description: Install Hashfuncs to plug industry-standard non-cryptographic algorithms into DuckDB queries — pair with bitfilters for ultra-fast set membership testing.
